# 网易云音乐自动任务
## 一、部署到腾讯云函数
### 修改配置
#### 账号密码
```
"users": [\
    {\
        "username": "188xxxx8888",\
        "countrycode": "",\
        "password": "mypassword",\
        "cookie": "MUSIC_U=[REDACTED];",\
        "X-Real-IP": "",\
        "enable": true\
    }\
],
// ...
```
